description: Read and write the bookmark keywords and tags that the standard bookmarks API doesn't expose.

functions.name: getAll
functions.description: Every keyword and every tag, as flat {keyword, url} / {tag, url} lists.

functions.name: setKeyword
functions.description: Make `keyword` the only keyword for `url`. An empty string removes the URL's keywords. A keyword already used by another URL is moved to this one.

functions.name: setTags
functions.description: Make `tags` the exact tag set for `url`.
